scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and exact finite verification supplied; earlier slice harmonic theory acknowledged; publication priority and independent validation not established.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for even n >= 4, balanced fixed-count sign probes, weighted nonnegative graph Laplacians and noiseless matrix-vector products only. If edges are available explicitly, trace is trivial. No universal dominance or query-optimality claim.
title: Balanced-sign Laplacian trace probing: an exact variance projection and zero-variance graph classification
